# is result of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:isResultOf`](gmeow-isResultOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/isResultOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)

Relates an entity (typically an observation result such as a quantity, coordinate set, or quality value) back to the [`Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) that produced it — the explicit provenance axis of the value×unit/frame×determinacy×provenance bundle. Domain is [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) (universal, matching the range of [`observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md)) so any result type can carry provenance. Non-functional: a result entity may be produced by multiple observations (e.g. a consensus value derived from several readings), and those claims coexist rather than collapse.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:isResultOf`](gmeow-isResultOf.md) from [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) to [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
